purpose: Own the declared clock domains, bounded current-time acquisition, directed source-to-destination mappings with tolerance, and the distinct regression/overflow/unknown/missing-mapping outcomes.
interfaces: declare_clock(ClockDomainId id, ClockSource source, ClockKind kind, Timestamp min, Timestamp max) -> Result
declare_mapping(ClockDomainId src, ClockDomainId dst, SignedOffset offset, Tolerance tolerance) -> Result
convert(ClockDomainId src, ClockDomainId dst, Timestamp value, Timestamp& out) -> Result
inputs: ClockDomainId, ClockSource (host-injected std::function<std::optional<Timestamp>()>), ClockKind, inclusive [min,max] bound, source/destination ids, signed offset, and Tolerance.
outputs: Result (UnknownClock, ClockSourceFailure, ClockOutOfBounds, ClockRegression, MissingMapping, ToleranceExceeded, ClockOverflow, CapacityExhausted, Ok) and, on success, a Timestamp via out parameter.
state: Clock-domain table (id, kind, source, [min,max], last observed reading) bounded by max_domains.
Directed mapping table (source, destination, offset, tolerance) bounded by max_mappings.
All mutable state guarded by a single std::mutex; non-copyable and non-movable.
errors: ClockSourceFailure: host source returned no reading.
ClockOutOfBounds: reading outside the declared inclusive bound.
ClockRegression: reading earlier than the prior reading in a monotonic domain.

ToleranceExceeded: mapped value diverges from destination current time beyond tolerance, measured as the full-range unsigned 64-bit distance over the signed ordering (exact over the signed 64-bit domain, maximum UINT64_MAX).
ClockOverflow: mapped value not representable in Timestamp.
CapacityExhausted: domain or mapping table is full.
invariants: No code path compares a raw timestamp from one domain with a raw timestamp from another; conversion requires a declared directed mapping.
A declared A->B mapping never enables B->A.
Reads never fabricate time and never fall back to another domain silently.
A rejected read leaves the regression baseline unchanged.
The tolerance distance is the full-range unsigned 64-bit magnitude computed from the signed ordering of the two values; it never wraps modulo 2^64 and never interprets a top bit as a sign bit.

A rejected conversion leaves the destination baseline, the output value, and all authority state unchanged; the destination baseline is committed only after overflow, bounds, and tolerance all pass, inside the same critical section.
The authority is non-copyable and non-movable.
concurrency: Internally synchronized with one std::mutex; concurrent now/convert calls serialize into a deterministic total order with no data race under ThreadSanitizer.

unit_cases.precondition: D_MONO is declared as a monotonic domain with a source returning 1000 within [0,1000000].
unit_cases.expected: Ok; out equals the source reading 1000.

unit_cases.precondition: Domain 0xDEAD is undeclared.
unit_cases.expected: UnknownClock; domain and mapping tables unchanged.

unit_cases.precondition: D_MONO source is set to return nullopt.
unit_cases.expected: ClockSourceFailure; baseline unchanged.

unit_cases.precondition: D_MONO source returns max+1 (outside declared bound).
unit_cases.expected: ClockOutOfBounds; baseline unchanged.

unit_cases.precondition: D_MONO source returns 1000 then 999.
unit_cases.expected: First Ok (1000); second ClockRegression with baseline still 1000; a later 1001 read returns Ok.

unit_cases.precondition: Mapping D_MONO->D_WALL declared with offset +5 and tolerance 10; sources agree within 5.
unit_cases.expected: Ok; out equals value+5 attributed to D_WALL.

unit_cases.precondition: Only D_MONO->D_WALL is declared.
unit_cases.expected: MissingMapping (reverse direction is not implied).

unit_cases.precondition: No mapping exists for D_MONO->D_OTHER.
unit_cases.expected: MissingMapping.

unit_cases.precondition: Mapped value diverges from destination now by tolerance+1.
unit_cases.expected: ToleranceExceeded; no mapping state mutated.

unit_cases.precondition: Mapped value diverges from destination now by exactly tolerance.
unit_cases.expected: Ok (tolerance comparison is <=).

unit_cases.precondition: value is INT64_MAX and offset is +1.
unit_cases.expected: ClockOverflow; distinct from ToleranceExceeded.

unit_cases.precondition: A regression source and a tolerance-failing mapping are prepared.
unit_cases.stimulus: Trigger a regression then a tolerance failure.
unit_cases.expected: Codes are distinguishable: ClockRegression != ToleranceExceeded.

unit_cases.precondition: source value INT64_MIN, destination now INT64_MAX, offset 0, full-range bounds, tolerance 1.
unit_cases.stimulus: Call convert with the negative-to-positive extreme pair.
unit_cases.expected: ToleranceExceeded (true distance is UINT64_MAX, not 1); baseline and output unchanged.

unit_cases.precondition: source value INT64_MAX, destination now INT64_MIN, offset 0, full-range bounds, tolerance 1.
unit_cases.stimulus: Call convert with the positive-to-negative extreme pair.
unit_cases.expected: ToleranceExceeded (true distance is UINT64_MAX); baseline and output unchanged.

unit_cases.precondition: A mapping whose distance is exactly UINT64_MAX is prepared; two tolerances are tested.
unit_cases.stimulus: Call convert with tolerance UINT64_MAX, then with tolerance UINT64_MAX - 1.
unit_cases.expected: tolerance UINT64_MAX -> Ok; tolerance UINT64_MAX - 1 -> ToleranceExceeded (boundary is <=).

unit_cases.precondition: Destination baseline is 100 from a successful read; the source reading is then changed to 200; the mapping fails tolerance.
unit_cases.stimulus: Call convert on the tolerance-failing mapping.
unit_cases.expected: ToleranceExceeded; destination baseline remains 100; a subsequent now() is unaffected (no spurious ClockRegression).

unit_cases.precondition: Each conversion failure class is set up in turn.
unit_cases.stimulus: Trigger UnknownClock, MissingMapping, ClockOverflow, ClockOutOfBounds, ClockSourceFailure, ClockRegression, and ToleranceExceeded.
unit_cases.expected: For every failure the destination baseline and the output value are byte-identical before and after (SR-015).

unit_cases.precondition: source value INT64_MIN, destination now INT64_MAX, offset 0, full-range bounds, tolerance 1 (rejected-state probe).
unit_cases.stimulus: Call convert and observe the result and state.
unit_cases.expected: ToleranceExceeded (distance UINT64_MAX); output and destination baseline unchanged.

unit_cases.precondition: Destination baseline initialized to 100; source reading changed to 200; a conversion fails tolerance (rejected-state probe).
unit_cases.stimulus: Call convert and observe the baseline afterward.
unit_cases.expected: ToleranceExceeded; baseline stays 100; a subsequent operation observes no ClockRegression attributable to the rejection.

unit_cases.precondition: D_MONO is declared; several threads are ready to read concurrently.
unit_cases.stimulus: Run concurrent now(D_MONO) calls from multiple threads.
unit_cases.expected: No data race (TSan clean); each read is deterministic and consistent with the serialized order.

static_checks.expected: clean (no diagnostic): copy/move are explicitly deleted and the destructor is trivial.
clean (no diagnostic): query/predicate locals are const.
No data race reported for concurrent now(D_MONO) calls.
clean: source and header formatted with no diff.

static_checks.rule: No raw cross-domain timestamp comparison (verification-plan STC-02)
static_checks.expected: Every time decision goes through declare/now/convert; no direct comparison of raw timestamps from different domains.
